text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Ines! For joining me in training 
so early in the morning!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, it's your birthday, Ryan-chan. 
I want to do anything I can for youâª

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see... Just do what I can...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, do you mind if I make one 
little request?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I want you to race me. Treat it like a 
real match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, is that asking for too much? 
Sorry, forget I said—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nope, of course it's fine! But, victory is 
the one present I won't just hand over 
easily!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, thank you! That'd be a huge help!"
